title: 第55章 小诗仙就是我！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 皇帝出手，早在唐逸意料之外了。不过想想，也算在意料之中。毕竟这段时间，唐敬的确跳得有点欢了。皇帝不敲打他，都对不起他！总之，是好事情。皇帝做了他最想做的事。“切，我才不信。”萧澜撇嘴。很快，她打量着唐逸的侧脸，嘴角又不由扬起，别说这家伙近看，还是怪好看的咧。那生的孩子，应该也会很好看的吧？“唐侍郎，接旨吧！”小太监宣读完圣旨，见到唐敬没动静，笑着提醒。唐敬这才回过神，颓着肩接旨：“臣，谢主隆恩。”小太监一甩拂尘，清了清嗓子，道：“传贤妃娘娘口谕：唐氏妇颜霜玉，心肠歹毒，苛待原配子女，赏一巴掌！”说完，小太监走到颜霜玉面前，恭敬行了一礼：“唐夫人，得罪了。”话落，扬手。啪！颜霜玉当场被打摔在地，打得她披头散发，满脸是血。但她依旧满脸震惊，难以置信，竟然为了唐音那个小贱人，贤妃竟然亲自下场敲打她。她一个后宫妃子，凭什么管官员内宅的事？全场死寂！谁都没想到，不仅皇帝惩罚了唐敬，连贤妃都没有放过颜霜玉。唐家的脸，今日算彻底丢光了。就连唐逸，此时也目瞪口呆，不愧是小姨，打得好。就俩字：解气。要不是因为身份限制，这个女人他早就想捶了。“公公，过分了。”唐画挡在母亲的面前，声音冰冷至极。小太监恭敬拱手道：“贤妃说了：本妃是唐逸和唐音的小姨，代其母行罚，天经地义，天下百官若不服，尽管上表弹劾本妃。”“告辞。”话落，小太监转身带着人走了。传旨太监走了，现场气氛却极为怪异。整个天香楼所有人面面相觑，谁都没有说话。“太子殿下，请问我现在可以走了吗？还是要继续大战一场，你选，我都奉陪。”最终，还是唐逸打破了沉默。只是这打破沉默的方式太强横，让无数人嘴角都在抽搐，你是嫌事情还不够大？还想将事情闹得再大点？萧澜也上前一步，坚定站在唐逸的身侧。孔诗岚和萧澜一起的，抿了抿唇，也只能站在唐逸的另一边。看着这一幕太子双眼阴翳得吓人，一个唐逸他不在意，可萧澜和孔诗岚，他不得不重视。“走吧。”太子挥了挥手，前方的太子卫让出了路。唐逸带着萧澜和孔诗岚转身离开。“唐敬，管好你的家事，这都什么乱七八糟的！”太子一甩衣袖冷哼一声，也带着人走了。“唐侍郎，家里该收衣服了，告辞。”“唐侍郎，家里小妾要生了，老夫得赶回去看看。”“……”太子走了，参加宴会的宾客，也都寻找借口开始离席。片刻功夫，整个天香楼就空荡荡的了。今日，他们见证了唐家的高光，同样的，今日，他们也见证了唐家的狼狈。接下来很长一段时间，唐家将会是京都的热门话题，饭后笑料。整个天香楼，只剩下了唐家一群老弱病残。唐敬手持圣旨脸色铁青，唐浩和林竹还躺在地上生死不知，颜霜玉扶着桌子摇摇晃晃，唐画则是看着门外的唐逸，恨意滔天。对他来说，这一切都是唐逸造成的！“老爷，他们太过分了……”颜霜玉可怜兮兮上前，想要唤醒这个男人的怜爱。“你们，很好！”唐敬闭上眼睛，冷冷地道：“回家，回祠堂！”今天太累了，他已经没有心思应对。而这时，出了天香楼的唐逸，再度向着躺在角落里的老太监走去。他恭恭敬敬行了一礼，道了谢，才转身离开。老太监自始至终都闭着眼睛，没有说话。直到唐逸走远，他才睁开眼来，看着唐逸的背影笑了起来：“是个有意思的少年，心性上乘，目前手段……暂时稍缺。”“不过，此人要是得到陛下重用，有了成长机会的话，将会是大敌。”“他？”从身后走出来的魏海微微一怔。“干爹是不是看错了？还有，干爹为何会准许他在酒楼胡闹？”“要是长公主追究下来，干爹少不了又要被训斥。”魏渊看了一眼手中的美酒，道：“因为，咱家也是有孙女的人，谁要是敢动咱家孙女，咱家会杀光他九族。”“至于训斥，若非咱家孙女需要照顾，咱家会害怕她训斥？”魏海闻言，面色不由一黯。干爹被迫出宫，就是因为他的孙女需要保护。其他人，他谁都信不过。不然，陈貂寺在他干爹面前，都得恭恭敬敬叫一声老祖宗。“唐逸，你是不是知道小诗仙是谁？”萧澜没有那么多弯弯绕绕，跟着唐逸走在街上，直接开门见山问道：“昨晚你们在幻音坊，梁绍不是说了吗？你们和诗仙是好兄弟。”“是认识。”唐逸想抽回自己的手，女人却抱得更紧了。他只能指了指自己，道：“我就是小诗仙，小诗仙就是我。”“真的？”萧澜美眸骤亮：“我就说嘛，我看上的人怎么会差。”孔诗岚指尖在萧澜额头敲了一下，没好气道：“笨蛋，也就你信，我查过了，他可是连学堂都没结业，字都认不全，会写诗？”“你也太高看他了。”孔诗岚怀疑过唐逸就是诗仙，可是经过仔细筛查后，得出的结论就是唐逸不可能是诗仙。她的怀疑早就被她推翻了。“唐逸，小诗仙到底是谁？方便透露下吗？我有事找他。”唐逸看了一眼身侧美眸略带哀求的孔诗岚，顿时一阵无语，诗仙就在你面前，你怎么就不相信呢？说了实话人家都不信，唐逸沉吟了一下，换了个说法：“放心吧，小诗仙也会参加沈园诗会，唐画不会独占鳌头。”“真的？”孔诗岚猛地拉住唐逸的手腕，幸福来得太突然，她有些难以置信。要知道这几日，为了找小诗仙，她可是耗费很大的心思。“真的，他亲口说的。”唐逸点头。闻言，孔诗岚才长长松了一口气。唐逸没有必要在这种事上骗她，她相信唐逸的话。萧澜却靠近唐逸，低声道：“岚姐不相信你，我相信你。”“我孩子的父亲，肯定不会差。”唐逸和孔诗岚：“……”这话要是传到皇帝的耳中，问题可就大了。“公主，有些事情吧，我觉得还是解释清楚比较好。”唐逸看着萧澜，脸色非常认真而郑重：“我那是在救你，而且亲一下，是不可能怀孕的……”萧澜美眸眨了眨，兴奋道：“是这样吗？那你跟着我回公主府，教教我怎么才能怀孕。”唐逸：“？？？”得，这天聊死了。……
content_en: The emperor took action long before Tang Yi expected it.But thinking about it, it’s expected.After all, during this period, Tang Jing did dance a little happily.Even if the emperor doesn't beat him, he will be sorry!All in all, it's a good thing.The emperor did what he wanted most."Tch, I don't believe it." Xiao Lan curled her lips.Soon, she looked at Tang Yi's side face and couldn't help but raise the corners of her mouth. Not to mention that this guy looked very good-looking up close.The child born then should also be very good-looking, right?"Tang Shilang, please accept the edict!" The young eunuch reminded him with a smile after reading out the imperial edict and seeing that Tang Jing remained motionless.Only then did Tang Jing come back to his senses, and received the order with a slumped shoulder: "Your Majesty, thank you for your kindness." The little eunuch flicked his fly whisk, cleared his throat, and said, "The Lady of the Concubine Chuanxian said: Yan Shuangyu, a woman of the Tang family, is evil-hearted and treats her first wife's children harshly. She will give her a slap!" After saying that, the little eunuch walked up to Yan Shuangyu and bowed respectfully: "Mrs. Tang, I'm offended." After saying this, he raised his hand.Snap!Yan Shuangyu was beaten to the ground on the spot, her hair disheveled and her face covered in blood.But her face was still filled with shock and disbelief that for the sake of that little bitch Tang Yin, Concubine Xian actually went out to beat her.As a concubine in the harem, why should she care about the affairs of an official's inner chamber?The whole place was dead silent!No one expected that not only the emperor punished Tang Jing, but also the concubine Yan Shuangyu was not spared.The Tang family's face was completely lost today.Even Tang Yi was dumbfounded at this time, she is indeed an aunt, she fought well.Just two words: relieve qi.If it weren't for his identity restrictions, he would have wanted to beat this woman up a long time ago."Eunuch, that's too much." Tang Hua stood in front of his mother, his voice extremely cold.The young eunuch respectfully raised his hands and said, "The concubine Xian said: I am the aunt of Tang Yi and Tang Yin, and it is natural and right to punish them on their mother's behalf. If all the officials in the world are dissatisfied, they can impeach me." "Farewell." After saying this, the young eunuch turned around and led the people away.The eunuch who delivered the order left, but the atmosphere at the scene was extremely strange.Everyone in Tianxiang Tower looked at each other, but no one spoke."Your Highness, can I leave now? Or should we continue to fight? You choose, and I will accompany you." In the end, Tang Yi broke the silence.It's just that this way of breaking the silence is too forceful and makes countless people's mouths twitch. Do you think the matter is not big enough?Still want to make things bigger?Xiao Lan also took a step forward and stood firmly beside Tang Yi.Kong Shilan and Xiao Lan pursed their lips together and could only stand on the other side of Tang Yi.Looking at this scene, the prince's eyes were frighteningly gloomy. He didn't care about Tang Yi, but he had to pay attention to Xiao Lan and Kong Shilan."Let's go." The prince waved his hand, and the prince's guard in front gave way.Tang Yi turned around and left with Xiao Lan and Kong Shilan."Tang Jing, take care of your family affairs, this is such a mess!" The prince waved his sleeves and snorted before leading the others away."Shilang Tang, it's time to collect the clothes at home. Let's say goodbye." "Shilang Tang, my concubine is about to give birth. I have to rush back and have a look." "..." The prince left, and the guests at the banquet also started to find excuses to leave.In a moment, the entire Tianxiang Tower was empty.Today, they witnessed the glory of the Tang family, and similarly, today, they also witnessed the embarrassment of the Tang family.For a long time to come, the Tang family will be a hot topic in Kyoto and a joke after dinner.In the entire Tianxiang Tower, only a group of old, weak, sick and disabled people from the Tang family were left.Tang Jing was holding the imperial edict and his face was livid, Tang Hao and Lin Zhu were still lying on the ground not knowing whether they were alive or dead, Yan Shuangyu was shaking on the table, and Tang Hua was looking at Tang Yi outside the door with overwhelming hatred.To him, all this was caused by Tang Yi!"Master, they went too far..." Yan Shuangyu stepped forward pitifully, trying to awaken the man's affection."You guys are fine!" Tang Jing closed his eyes and said coldly: "Go home, go back to the ancestral hall!" He was too tired today and he had no time to deal with it.At this time, Tang Yi, who had left Tianxiang Tower, walked towards the old eunuch lying in the corner again.He bowed respectfully, thanked him, and then turned and left.The old eunuch kept his eyes closed from beginning to end and did not speak.It wasn't until Tang Yi walked away that he opened his eyes, looked at Tang Yi's back and smiled: "He is an interesting young man, with a good heart, but his current methods... are temporarily lacking." "However, if this person is reused by His Majesty and has the opportunity to grow, he will be a formidable enemy." "Him?" Wei Hai, who came out from behind, was slightly startled."Did the godfather make a mistake? Also, why did the godfather allow him to fool around in the restaurant?" "If the eldest princess pursues him, the godfather will inevitably be reprimanded again." Wei Yuan glanced at the wine in his hand and said, "Because,Our family also has a granddaughter. If anyone dares to touch our granddaughter, our family will kill all the nine members of his family."As for scolding, if our granddaughter doesn't need to be taken care of, will our family be afraid of her scolding?"Wei Hai's face darkened when he heard this.The godfather was forced to leave the palace because his granddaughter needed protection.He couldn't trust anyone else.Otherwise, Chen Diao Si would have to respectfully call him "ancestor" in front of his godfather."Tang Yi, do you know who Xiao Shixian is?" Xiao Lan followed Tang Yi on the street without so many twists and turns, and asked straight to the point: "Didn't Liang Shao tell you last night when you were at Huanyinfang? You and Shixian are good brothers." "We know each other." Tang Yi wanted to withdraw his hand, but the woman hugged him tighter.He could only point at himself and said: "I am the Little Poet Fairy, and the Little Poet Fairy is me." "Really?" Xiao Lan's beautiful eyes suddenly lit up: "I'm just telling you, how could the person I like be so bad?" Kong Shilan tapped Xiao Lan's forehead with her fingertips, and said angrily: "Idiot,You believe it?I checked, but he didn't even graduate from school, can't read all the words, and can write poetry?" "You think too highly of him." Kong Shilan had suspected that Tang Yi was the Poetry Immortal, but after careful screening, he came to the conclusion that Tang Yi could not be the Poetry Immortal.Her suspicions had long been overturned."Tang Yi, who is the little Shixian? Can you reveal it conveniently? I have something to ask him." Tang Yi glanced at Kong Shilan, whose beautiful eyes were pleading beside him, and was speechless for a moment. Shixian is right in front of you, why don't you believe it?People didn't believe the truth. Tang Yi pondered for a moment and then said something else: "Don't worry, the little Shixian will also participate in the Shenyuan Poetry Festival, and Tang Hua will not be the best." "Really?" Kong Shilan suddenly grabbed Tang Yi's wrist. The happiness came so suddenly, she couldn't believe it.You must know that in the past few days, she had spent a lot of effort to find Xiao Shixian."real
title_en: Chapter 55 The little Shixian is me!
